title: Administrative event years (pseudonymised)
description: Participant-level administrative events/years with pseudo-anonymised identifier, shifted entry date and date of birth.

TCode.title: Pseudo-anonymized 8-character study identifier.
TCode.description: Pseudo-anonymized 8-character study identifier for all research datasets in RDS.

AgeEntry.title: Age at entry (years)
AgeEntry.description: Up to date fields from People table and questionnaire received date to create Age at Entry. This variable is derived directly from raw data and the references to variables it is derived from is not another schema, they are references to the SQL database->table->column.

DateOfBirth_Shifted.title: Shifted Date of birth
DateOfBirth_Shifted.description: Using up to date fields from People table in the Mailing database. This variable is derived directly from raw data and the references to variables it is derived from is not another schema, they are references to the SQL database->table->column.

YearOfBirth.title: Year of birth
YearOfBirth.description: The birth year before it is shifted for pseudo-anonymization. This variable is derived directly from raw data and the references to variables it is derived from is not another schema, they are references to the SQL database->table->column.

EntryDate_Shifted.title: Shifted Entry date
EntryDate_Shifted.description: Shifted date of study entry derived from EventDate where Event = 6 (date questionnaire received), pseudo-anymised by adding Random.

EntryYear.title: Year of entry
EntryYear.description: Actual year of questionnaire completion, or if no date of completion, the date the questionnaire was received.

R1Completion.title: Baseline completion (year)
R1Completion.description: Year of baseline questionnaire completion. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R1Received.title: Baseline questionnaire received (year)
R1Received.description: Year baseline questionnaire received. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R1BloodReceived.title: Baseline blood pack received (year)
R1BloodReceived.description: Year baseline blood pack received. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R2Completion.title: Second follow up completion (year)
R2Completion.description: Year of second follow-up questionnaire completion. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R2Received.title: Second follow up received (year)
R2Received.description: Year of second follow-up questionnaire received. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R3Completion.title: Third follow up completion (year)
R3Completion.description: Year of thrird follow-up questionnaire completion. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R3Received.title: Third follow up received (year)
R3Received.description: Year of third follow-up questionnaire received. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R4Completion.title: Fourth follow-up completion (year)
R4Completion.description: Year of fourth follow-up questionnaire completion. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R4Received.title: Fourth follow-up received (year)
R4Received.description: Year of fourth follow-up questionnaire received. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table

R5Completion.title: Fifth follow up completion (year)
R5Completion.description: Year of fifth follow-up questionnaire completion. Loaded directly from the TrueYear table
